description: Irrevocably delete old vault secrets from prod tier1 (irreversible)

playbook.content:
- name: Delete old vault secrets
  hosts: production_tier1
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/vault/old_secrets.yml
        state: absent

tier_rationale: Irreversible deletion on production tier1, regulatory host
